articles.title: Azure Policy, Part 1: What Is an Azure Policy?
articles.description: Part 1 of a seven-part series on Azure Policy: what a policy definition actually is, how the if/then rule works, aliases, the full list of effects and the order they run in, modes, versioning, and the limits that bite in production.
articles.summary: Understand the Policy objects, trace a storage rule and choose an effect before assigning it.
articles.author: Benoit G

articles.title: Azure Policy, Part 2: What Is an Initiative (Policy Set)?
articles.description: Part 2 of the Azure Policy series: policy set definitions explained - grouping definitions, policyDefinitionReferenceId, passing parameters down, definition groups and regulatory compliance, version pinning, and the initiative parameter you can never change.
articles.summary: Group definitions into an initiative, distinguish member IDs and trace how parameter values reach each policy.
articles.author: Benoit G

articles.title: Azure Policy, Part 3: What Is a Policy Assignment?
articles.description: Part 3 of the Azure Policy series: assignments are where governance becomes real. Scope and inheritance, enforcementMode, managed identities and remediation permissions, resourceSelectors and overrides for safe rollout, and non-compliance messages.
articles.summary: Choose scope, enforcement and identity permissions before applying a policy or starting remediation.
articles.author: Benoit G

articles.title: Azure Policy, Part 4: What Is an Exclusion (notScopes)?
articles.description: Part 4 of the Azure Policy series: exclusions explained. How notScopes carves a hole in an assignment scope, why excluded resources vanish from compliance entirely, the governance debt it creates, and when an exclusion is genuinely the right answer.
articles.summary: Decide between an exclusion and a tracked exemption, then record the scope and controls affected.
articles.author: Benoit G

articles.title: Azure Policy, Part 5: What Is a Policy Exemption?
articles.description: Part 5 of the Azure Policy series: exemptions explained. Waiver versus Mitigated, expiresOn, exempting a single initiative member, identity-based exemptions, compliance substate, the RBAC you need, and how to stop exemptions becoming permanent.
articles.summary: Configure a justified exception with a reason, owner and expiry, then review it through its lifecycle.
articles.author: Benoit G

articles.title: Azure Policy, Part 6: Azure Policy as Code
articles.description: Part 6 of the Azure Policy series: why the portal stops working at scale, Microsoft's create-test-deploy workflow, the deployment ordering problem, drift and desired state, the managed identity permission gap, and what to put in your repository.
articles.summary: Prepare a versioned repository, test scope and reviewed deployment pipeline for your Policy objects.
articles.author: Benoit G

articles.title: Azure Policy, Part 7: EPAC and the Alternatives
articles.description: Part 7 of the Azure Policy series: Enterprise Azure Policy as Code (EPAC) explained end to end - folder structure, global-settings.jsonc, pacEnvironments, desired state strategies, the three-stage pipeline, ALZ integration - plus an honest comparison with ALZ, Terraform, AzOps and doing nothing.
articles.summary: Evaluate EPAC against alternatives, understand desired-state deletion and plan a phased adoption.
articles.author: Benoit G

articles.title: Azure Lighthouse: Choose a Cross-Tenant Management Pattern
articles.description: Choose between application maintenance, multi-tenant operations and ISV delegation, then review Lighthouse scope, role limitations, rollout and revocation.
articles.author: Benoit G

articles.title: DNS in Azure, Part 3: Azure DNS Private Resolver
articles.description: Part 3 of the DNS in Azure series: inbound and outbound endpoints, forwarding rulesets, the query evaluation order, the centralized and distributed architectures, and how to log DNS queries without running your own servers.
articles.summary: Choose a hybrid DNS pattern from the client and destination, then trace its inbound or outbound query path.
articles.author: Benoit G

articles.title: DNS in Azure, Part 4: Private Link and Private Endpoints
articles.description: Part 4 of the DNS in Azure series: what a Private Endpoint really is, sub-resources, the approval workflow, routing and NSG behaviour, Private Link Service, and why turning off public network access is a separate job.
articles.summary: Separate endpoint approval, DNS and network checks, and treat public-access restrictions as a distinct action.
articles.author: Benoit G

articles.title: DNS in Azure, Part 5: Private Endpoints and Private DNS
articles.description: Part 5 of the DNS in Azure series: the privatelink CNAME chain, the exact zone name for every service, private DNS zone groups, running zones at scale with Azure Policy, and making Private Endpoints resolve from on-premises.
articles.summary: Trace the public-to-private CNAME chain, find the exact service zone and verify the answer from your client.
articles.author: Benoit G

articles.title: DNS in Azure, Part 6: Private DNS Fallback to Internet
articles.description: Part 6 of the DNS in Azure series: why a privatelink zone returns NXDOMAIN for names you do not own, how the NxDomainRedirect resolution policy fixes cross-tenant Private Link, and when you should deliberately leave it off.
articles.summary: Decide whether a public fallback is acceptable, inventory the link policy and compare lookup results.
articles.author: Benoit G

articles.title: DNS in Azure, Part 7: DNS Security Policies
articles.description: Part 7 of the DNS in Azure series: DNS resolver policies, traffic rules and domain lists, the Microsoft threat intelligence feed, full query logging in Log Analytics, and a rollout plan that will not take your platform down.
articles.summary: Understand rule priority and domain matching, observe DNS queries and plan a controlled filtering rollout.
articles.author: Benoit G

articles.title: DNS in Azure, Part 8: The Resolution Decision Tree
articles.description: Part 8 of the DNS in Azure series: an interactive decision tree that takes you from a client asking for a name to the exact Azure architecture that answers it - Azure DNS, private zones, privatelink, forwarding rulesets, or on-premises.
articles.summary: Answer a few questions to choose a DNS resolution path, then copy or share the diagnostic.
articles.author: Benoit G

articles.title: DNS in Azure, Part 2: Private DNS Zones
articles.description: Part 2 of the DNS in Azure series: how private DNS zones and virtual network links really work, what autoregistration does to your records, the privatelink zones behind Private Endpoints, and how to design zones you will not regret.
articles.summary: Create and link a private zone, distinguish registration from resolution and verify a full-name lookup.
articles.author: Benoit G

articles.title: DNS in Azure, Part 1: Fundamentals and Azure-Provided Name Resolution
articles.description: Part 1 of an eight-part series on private DNS in Azure: the vocabulary, the 168.63.129.16 platform IP, where a VM actually gets its resolver from, and why the default internal.cloudapp.net namespace runs out of road.
articles.summary: Identify which resolver a client uses and distinguish Azure-provided DNS from private and hybrid resolution.
